name: Invader Out of Space

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

traits.name: Alien Mind
traits.summary: A creature that tries to read its mind or deals it Psychic damage must make a DC 16 Int save or be Stunned for 1 minute (new save at the end of each of its turns).
traits.text: If a creature tries to read the invader's mind or deals Psychic damage to it, that creature must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or have the Stunned condition for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Gliding Levitation
traits.summary: Hovers 6 inches up and leaves no tracks; ignores Difficult Terrain from ground conditions, moves over liquids, takes no fall damage.
traits.text: The invader hovers 6 inches above the ground and leaves no tracks. It ignores Difficult Terrain caused by conditions on the ground, can move over liquids, and takes no damage from falling.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
traits.text: The invader has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Weak Constitution
traits.summary: Disadvantage on saves to avoid or end the Poisoned condition; if Poisoned at the start of its turn it takes 20 Necrotic.
traits.text: The invader has Disadvantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition. If the invader is Poisoned at the start of its turn, it takes 20 Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Three Disrupting Touch attacks, and Unnerving Glare too if it is ready.
actions.text: The invader makes three Disrupting Touch attacks and uses Unnerving Glare if it is available.

actions.name: Disrupting Touch

params.keeps: magic items and worn or carried equipment

actions.summary: +8, 2d10+4 Force; a creature it kills or an object it destroys becomes fine gray dust (magic items and equipment are left behind).
actions.text: 15 (2d10 + 4) Force damage. A creature killed or an object destroyed by this damage is reduced to a fine gray dust. Magic items, and any equipment worn or carried by a creature turned to dust, are not disintegrated.

actions.name: Unnerving Glare
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. One creature it sees within 60 ft: DC 16 Wis save or Incapacitated until the start of its next turn.
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the invader can see within 60 feet. Failure: the target has the Incapacitated condition until the start of the invader's next turn.

reactions.name: Otherworldly Slip
reactions.summary: When it takes damage, teleports up to 60 ft to a free space it sees, and can burst a 30-ft Emanation where it left or arrived: DC 16 Int save, 3d10 Psychic (half on a success) and Speed halved on a failure.
reactions.text: Trigger: the invader takes damage. Response: the invader teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet and can cause the following. Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the space where the invader vanished or appeared (its choice). Failure: 16 (3d10) Psychic damage, and the target's Speed is halved until the end of its next turn. Success: half damage only.

summary: A robed, silent star-traveller that disintegrates foes to gray dust with its touch, blinks away when hurt and stuns minds that probe it; poison is its weakness.
